name: Decollate Decoration!
original_name: でこれいと・でこれいしょん！
source:
One day, all of a sudden, you find yourself becoming a ghost.
You've never committed any evil. Your soul would surely be judged favorably.

It no longer mattered how great of a place it was.
The thought of being separated from him sounded more terrifying than purgatory.

You know what you need to do...

If you can't visit him anymore...
Then you have to bring him with you!
You're sure he would understand.
You need to bring him to your side before your spirit passes on.

You have to XXXX your beloved...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155570/Decollate_Decoration/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，你突然发现自己变成了一个幽灵。
你从来没有做过任何恶事。你的灵魂肯定会受到有利的评价。

它是一个多么伟大的地方已经不再重要了。
与他分离的念头听起来比炼狱还要可怕。

你知道你需要做什么…

如果你不能再去看他了…
那你就得带他一起去！
你确信他会理解的。
在你的灵魂消逝之前，你需要把他带到你身边。

你必须XXXX你心爱的…

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155570/Decollate_Decoration/]Steam[/url]]
